usgs.summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 55 fountaining ended yesterday at 9:03 a.m. HST. Summit reinflation continues today following the end of the fountaining.

recentForecasts.windowText: forecast window for onset of episode 55 fountaining is now September 10-11

methodology: TurkeySci Bayesian product of all Gaussian forecast-window likelihoods in the active episode, with recency and narrowness weighting
